hero_headline: How tissues bear load, remodel, and repair.
hero_intro: We combine mechanics, imaging, and materials science to understand soft tissues of the female reproductive tract, design scaffolds that regenerate bone, and engineer surfaces that help coral reefs recover.
research_intro: Collagen-rich tissues and engineered materials share a common language: structure, mechanics, and remodeling. We study that language across scales.
